import system

	data = []
	if value is None:
		return data

	# Toggle value on the view (defined at root.custom.chartMode)
	mode = self.view.getChild("root").custom.chartMode  # "count" or "volume"

	# Convert dataset to iterable
	pyData = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(value)

	# Determine target based on mode
	target = 120 if mode == "count" else 6

	for row in pyData:
		hourBucket = row['hour_bucket']
		pyDate = system.date.fromMillis(hourBucket.getTime())
		formatted = system.date.format(pyDate, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")

		# Decide which value column to use
		chartValue = row['entry_count'] if mode == "count" else row['total_volume']

		# Determine color
		if chartValue >= target:
			color = "#61BEDA"  # blue
		else:
			color = "#FF8C00"  # orange

		# Append to dataset
		data.append({
			"hour": formatted,     # X-axis
			"value": chartValue,   # Y-axis (bar)
			"target": target,      # Second axis line
			"color": color,        # Bar color
			"volume": row['total_volume']
		})

	return data
